column2: Lu Lingqi, an adult woman officer in full plate armor, standing guard with a short halberd planted upright at her side, long hair tied with ribbons blowing in the wind, looking back over her shoulder. A woman's face, no beard or mustache. Expression: proud, spirited.

Lady Zhurong, queen of a southern tribe, in a feathered headdress and full leather armor, holding a short spear upright in one hand, a row of small throwing knives at her belt, head turned to the side. Expression: proud, steady.
a court lady in formal robes holding a round silk fan, turned three-quarter, looking down. Expression: composed, gentle.
